The lead rule catches active first-person wording ("we overrule", "is accordingly overruled") and misses declaratory wording: "stand(s) overruled", "is/are overruled", "do not lay down the correct law" (plural), "must be held to have been wrongly decided". The README Limits section does not disclose this.
